reason: Measured and confirmed. b.css:754-755 sets padding-left 0 at rest and gap-snug on :hover only; transition-property is 'border-color, background-color', so the box jumps 144.6px to 156.6px with no ease at the instant the pointer lands. Keyboard focus-visible matches but gets none of it: padding 0, border transparent, colour fore-72. Tab order confirmed one step past Done. One overstatement: it is not drawn like .b-inert (mono, uppercase, label size), and the global focus ring does fire, so the control is not invisible to keyboard.
sharpenedFix: Do not reserve the indent with padding, which pushes the label off the editor's left column. Keep the label anchored and let the border grow outward: .b-editDanger .b-act { border-color: transparent; color: var(--fore-72); padding-left: var(--gap-snug); margin-left: calc(var(--gap-snug) * -1); } constant at rest, then .b-editDanger .b-act:hover, .b-editDanger .b-act:focus-visible { border-color: var(--fore-46); color: var(--fore); }. Both animated properties are already in the transition list; nothing reflows. Verify the -12px against .b-edit's 16px gutter at 390px. Extend the accessible name via aria-label templated from the item's title, never hardcoded, so textContent stays 'Delete this moment' and interaction-check.mjs:549 keeps passing.
